audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows were inverted against both the packet and this page's own whys — Level 1 was given to Irelia while whys[0] says 'You out-range her at level 1', and Level 6 was given to Irelia while whys[4] says your full combo 'wins this all-in'.
audit.why: Packet reads Kennen, Skill, Irelia, Irelia, Kennen, Irelia, Kennen, which matches the prose: Kennen owns level 1 range, level 3 through 5 belong to the Bladesurge-into-Flawless-Duet rhythm, level 6 is the Slicing Maelstrom all-in, first item is hers, two items swing back.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3, 4 and 5 flipped as matched full/content pairs, with the 3/10 ratings on rows 0 and 4 raised to 7/10 so the numbers agree with the sides. The mirror flipped exactly these five rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Trade around Flawless Duet's cooldown' with no number, and Bladesurge treated as a plain dash.
audit.why: Flawless Duet is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s — a 16-second gap at rank 1 is the whole window you get. Bladesurge is 10/9/8/7/6s but 'if the target is Marked or dies to Bladesurge, its cooldown refreshes', so on a marked target it is effectively free. Vanguard's Edge is 125/105/85s against your flat 120s R.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt with the 16s E, the refreshing Bladesurge and the flat 120s R.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six fields tell the player to bait or fear Defiant Dance blocking his poke and his R burst, and two of them say it heals.
audit.why: Riot's text is 'She takes reduced physical damage during the charge' — Kennen deals magic damage with his entire kit, so Defiant Dance blunts none of it. The healing is on Bladesurge, not on W. Playing around a block that does not exist wastes the one 16s window her E gives you.
audit.corrected: whys[3], spikes[2].text, spikes[3].text, mid, late, wants.you[2] and wants.foe[1] rewritten: Defiant Dance reduces physical only, the heal is credited to Bladesurge, and the defensive rule becomes counting marks and respecting the E timer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing about Vanguard's Edge leaving a wall behind you.
audit.why: Its text ends 'the blades form a wall that will damage and slow enemies that walk through it', and Kennen has no dash — Lightning Rush is a 170-range movement form, not a leap.
audit.corrected: Stated in late: hold Flash for the wall, not the damage.

edits.before: She owns the hard-commit window — her W blocks your poke and heals while her E stun punishes any overstep with R still down.
edits.after: She owns the hard-commit window — Defiant Dance cuts physical damage only, but her E stun punishes any overstep while your R is down.

edits.before: Slicing Maelstrom + E-in stun-locks her through her dashes — your single best all-in window, even into her W block.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom + E-in stun-locks her through her dashes — your single best all-in window; Defiant Dance blunts no magic.

edits.before: Her first item (Trinity/Sundered Sky) plus passive shred turns extended fights her way — bait her W, then re-engage.
edits.after: Her first item (Trinity/Sundered Sky) plus stacked attack speed turns fights her way — commit on her 16s E, never off it.

edits.before: Bait her W (Defiant Dance) damage-block, then E-in and dump Q-W marks once it drops
edits.after: Count your marks and step out at two, so her E stun never lands mid-third application

edits.before: Use W (Defiant Dance) to block your R burst and heal back your poke
edits.after: Heal your whole poke back with Bladesurge resets off the wave and off you

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are her window — she hits her Q-reset-into-E-stun rhythm and W blocks your poke while healing, so don't commit when her E is up. Hold your E (Lightning Rush) to dash OUT as she dashes IN, breaking the stun chain before she lands it. Then level 6 flips it hard: Slicing Maelstrom plus your E-in stun-locks her through her dashes — that's your cleanest all-in, and even her W block can't save her once Mark of the Storm starts stunning. Bait the W first, then dump R + Q + W marks.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are her window — she hits her Q-reset-into-E-stun rhythm and heals it all back off Bladesurge, so don't commit while her 16s E is up. Hold Lightning Rush to move OUT as she dashes IN, breaking the chain before the stun lands. Then level 6 flips it hard: Slicing Maelstrom plus your E-in stun-locks her through her dashes — that's your cleanest all-in, and Defiant Dance reduces physical damage, so it does nothing against your kit at all.

edits.before: Her first item (Trinity Force / Sundered Sky) plus passive armor shred reclaims the extended-trade window — if you fight her with R down, her sustain and DPS grind your squishy body out, so don't sidelane-duel her on cooldown. But you spike back at your AP item: once Hextech Alternator or Rocketbelt lands, your R combo bursts her faster than her W can block or heal, and your AoE stun-lock makes you the better teamfight and 2v2 threat. Close around your item spikes — pick her off with R before she snowballs into a true late-game duelist.
edits.after: Her first item (Trinity Force / Sundered Sky) plus stacked attack speed reclaims the extended-trade window — if you fight her with R down, her sustain and DPS grind your squishy body out, so don't sidelane-duel her on cooldown. Vanguard's Edge also leaves a wall behind you and you have no dash, so hold Flash for the wall, not the damage. You spike back at your AP item: the R combo bursts her, and your AoE stun-lock makes you the better teamfight threat.

edits.before: - Irelia Flawless Duet: matchup-defining — Her engage CC. E-dash/dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Irelia Flawless Duet: matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1, the stun that starts every all-in. Step up once it is spent. - Bladesurge (10s, and it refreshes on a Marked target). - Your R: flat 120s, kill windows only.

notes: The 'Defiant Dance blocks your poke / your R burst' claim was on this page in six fields; Riot's text says it reduces physical damage and Kennen's kit is entirely magic, so the advice was actively harmful. The healing belongs to Bladesurge. Chart rows and the two 3/10 ratings were proposed as one group.
